animation.scope: Full native animation poses; quantized endpoints follow their assigned native joints. Native source vertices and authored connection endpoints are transformed under their assigned joints. Native root offsets translate both native and authored geometry equally. Fins and tail are reviewed in all five clips; no claim of watertight topology.

native.scope: Land underground hiding, ambush/glide/dive/return, recoil/stun/death, underground instant-defeat reward, circle contacts, decoy reward exclusion and both interrupted/normal cleanup. Water placement, swim, breach predicate and airborne updates, recoil/stun/death. Native scale/collision/root offsets, palettes, gates, distance fallback, caches and scene teardown.
native.fixture_limits: Isolated debug profile; pinned player and camera. Collision/damage stimuli and attack setup calls are supplied. The breach test supplies near-surface positions, water distances, facing and a fresh floor query before invoking the original attack function. The player update is held for 21 ticks during this short breach fixture. It does not establish unassisted natural breach frequency or full dungeon coverage.
